title: Director Spike Jonze on AI Illusion of Progress at Vibecon '26 🤖 @replit  #ai
description:
The director of the movie Her, Spike Jonze, explains that AI gives you the illusion of progress, but not real progress, at the Replit Vibecon 2026.

​He points out that the speed at which Claude and other AI tools complete tasks causes you to miss the challenging, but essential, part of learning.

#ai #artificialintelligence #spikejonze #replit
